title: A local observatory
narration: Welcome to SKYSHIFT, an independent student application running on this computer. This records the actual website, with scripted interactions and a generic computer voice. The exploration tools use traceable SPHEREx observations.

title: Choose a real sky region
narration: Start with Explore. Each card describes a real sky region and tells you what is available. M67 and NGC 188 offer single exposure exploration. Their tested observation pairs did not pass our wavelength screen. We keep them available to explore without presenting an incompatible time comparison.

title: Understand the image and its sources
narration: M101 is the Pinwheel Galaxy. This infrared cutout shows only part of its central region. The blue gaps mark excluded or unsupported data, not empty sky. Open the source panel to find the original observation and processing record. The displayed colors represent infrared intensity, not visible colors.

title: Two dates, with explicit limits
narration: Compare focuses on a much smaller area from the seventh and eleventh of December, twenty twenty five. The dates share a prepared grid and display scale. Only this limited area passed the engineering wavelength screen. The pair still needs qualified scientific assessment. An apparent difference alone does not establish a changing astronomical object.

title: Explore without inventing detail
narration: Switch dates to hold the same sky position steady. Zoom and pan together, then reset the view. Image appearance controls are optional. Inspect prepared pixels to see the underlying resolution. A smoother display helps viewing, but creates no additional scientific detail. False color is a display choice, not a different observation.

title: Save a question and its evidence
narration: Notice something worth checking? Add a note directly on the image. SKYSHIFT attaches the sky position, so you can focus on writing a question. This example is explicitly a demonstration, not a discovery. Save the comparison to download the prepared data, question, view settings, hashes, and original source references together.

title: Reopen the comparison
narration: After reloading the page, open the saved comparison. The question and viewing settings return. The full review packet separately preserves original observations and calibration inputs for reproducible offline reconstruction with the scientific tools. Integrity checks help preserve the evidence; they do not grant scientific approval.

title: Trust comes from clear limits
narration: SKYSHIFT keeps real observations, clear controls, and evidence together. Scientific approval remains pending. Explore locally, ask careful questions, and keep the data behind what you see.
